trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **Cause:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with 18% of requests failing. Its test build (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging before it went out.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release marked healthy in production. After the rollback, all three regions are running it, the service is healthy and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the next step: find out why v2.3.1 failed before it's deployed again. The first attempt to open it was rate-limited. I retried with the same request ID, which stops it from being created twice.

content.text: Most recent healthy production release is v2.3.0.
